reviews.text:
I received excellent and attentive service right from the initial consultation.

I imagine it was quite a challenge due to the numerous tangles, but by the end, there wasn't a single tangle left, and it was wonderfully fluffy (thank you!).

I'll definitely be using your services again!

I was struggling to decide what to do about my dog's first grooming experience, so I was browsing Instagram... and that's how I found this place. I thought, "This place might bring out the best in my dog!" and decided to visit!

The service was very thorough, and they really thought about my dog. My husband and I were both very satisfied with the adorable result!🤣🤣
My dog ​​was also very well-behaved, so I was really impressed by the professionals...
Next time, it's the day before her birthday, so I'll have her made even cuter!! 🩷
Thank you so much!

We look forward to seeing you again! ✨

I recently moved to this area and visited your shop for the first time the other day. I was a little anxious since it was my first time there, but I was relieved to hear that my dog ​​was well-behaved by the groomer, which made me feel confident about bringing him here. I was also able to watch him getting his hair cut from outside, and he looked adorable. I look forward to seeing you again.

I used this salon based on a recommendation from a groomer at a salon I used to frequent.

They did a really cute haircut, and my dog's fur stayed fluffy for quite a while after the grooming, which was wonderful.

The pick-up and drop-off service was also a great help.

They also have a dog run and pet hotel, which is very appealing, and I would definitely like to use those services next time.

While out for a walk, I asked someone which grooming salon they used, and they recommended Ribron.
First, I used their overnight hotel service.
They sent me videos of my dog's walks, which was reassuring and allowed me to see how he was doing.
This time, I waited until he was seven months old to finally bring him in for grooming.
I was very satisfied with how cute he looked, just as I had hoped. I made a reservation for my next visit before leaving, and I'm already looking forward to seeing how he'll be groomed next time.

This was my first visit, and I was treated with great care from the initial consultation to the final handover. They listened carefully to my requests regarding the grooming, and I was very satisfied. The shop was clean and bright, and I was very happy with the post-grooming photo service and the video of my dog ​​being shampooed. I would definitely like to use their services again next time. Thank you very much.

Since he was a puppy, we went to a different salon until he was 7 months old, but he's finally old enough to come here for the first time.

Just as I expected, and exactly as I wanted, he got a stylish haircut, and I'm extremely satisfied.

I'd heard that all my friends who walk their dogs here go here, and I can see why.

When I told my daughter's friend, a groomer, that we go here, she said, "Wow, it's a famous salon that's even been featured in magazines!"

I'm so glad there's such a wonderful salon within walking distance.

We look forward to continuing to use your services!

This was my first time using your services. I was struggling to find a suitable grooming service when I saw a flyer at the vet clinic I go to. After researching your website and other sources, I was so impressed by how cute all the dogs looked after their grooming! I decided to visit with the hope of having my own dog groomed there as well. My dog's summer cut had grown out a bit, so they couldn't achieve the style I wanted yet, but they still made her look cuter than before, and I'm so grateful! (I'm totally a doting parent!) The salon was very clean, and they had adorable resident dogs (apparently the staff's pet dogs), so I would definitely like to use their services again in the future. I look forward to seeing you again next month.

About a month ago, my daughter's piano teacher recommended this salon to me, so I came here for the first time.
Since she was still a puppy, I tried out a few different salons, but I was very satisfied with the results at this salon!!
I never thought my puppy would have such a great haircut!!
I realized how much a haircut can make a difference!
I was surprised when I went to pick her up, because she didn't want to leave!
I felt so comfortable there that I'll definitely come here again.
I look forward to seeing you again next time.

This was my first time using their services, and I was incredibly impressed by their high level of skill and extremely courteous service!

After the grooming was finished, they sent me adorable photos of my dog ​​during the shampoo and the finished look. Their consistently polite communication made me feel very at ease.

I highly recommend this salon!
